summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to ¥87.00 from prior forecast of ¥77.00, including interim dividend of ¥42.00 and revised year-end dividend of ¥45.00. Increase reflects upward revision of full-year earnings forecast, with payout ratio targeting 40%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Business Forecast and Revision of Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Tokyo Radiator Manufacturing has revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, raising the annual dividend per share to ¥87.00 from the previously announced forecast of ¥77.00. The interim dividend, determined at ¥42.00 per share with a record date of September 30, 2026, was increased from the prior forecast of ¥38.00. The year-end dividend has been revised upward to ¥45.00 per share from the prior forecast of ¥39.00.

This revision reflects an upward adjustment to the full-year consolidated earnings forecast announced on May 14, 2026. The company upgraded its sales forecast to ¥38,500 million from ¥35,500 million, operating profit to ¥2,900 million from ¥2,450 million, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders to ¥2,050 million from ¥1,800 million. The improvements were driven by strong performance in Japan and Asia, particularly in automotive and construction machinery segments, offset partially by expected weakness in China.

The company's fundamental dividend policy targets a payout ratio of approximately 40%. The annual dividend increase of ¥22.00 per share compared to the prior fiscal year reflects this commitment to shareholder returns aligned with earnings growth.
